generations.prompt: Inside a crowded, smoky medieval tavern at night, low black beams and a roaring hearth. A jongleur in a hooded green-and-yellow tunic with a belt of small bells stands on a trestle table holding three flaming torches; he spins on one foot on the tabletop with the torches held out at arm's length so the flames streak into rings of fire, the bells flying, the crowd below roaring and raising tankards; a thrown tankard flies past his head and he ducks, then leaps over the landlord's broom swung at his legs and lands on the table again with the torches held high. Firelight and smoke. Medium-wide, the camera nearly static. Photoreal, cinematic film look, 35mm, shallow depth of field, film grain. No text, no captions.
